text:
Maya: heads-up — onboarding samplekit hit a weird JSON-mode failure when auth retries kicked in during today's traffic spike. stack shows the `tool_call` payload with inner `args` serialized as a string instead of an object. @ben any ideas?

ci-bot: [alert] samplekit/onboard #build-342 failed 7x in 2m: validator error: unexpected string for object field 'args'

Ben: can you paste the failing request body? which SDK (node/python)?

Maya: node 1.12.0. short repro: `{'tool_call':'{"name":"search","args":"{"q":"cats"}"}'}` — inner args got quoted twice on retry.

Rachel: ah, parity issue. node helper runs `serializeToolCall()` inside the auth retry wrapper while the python helper delays serialization. thats why only node breaks under concurrent refresh.

Sam: quick fix: make serialize idempotent — if args is a string and parses to JSON, don't stringify again. add e2e test that fires 5 concurrent refreshes.

Ben: i'll open a PR to sdk-helper with unit + e2e tests and coordinate infra to replay the CI surge.

Maya: workaround: set `auth.retryBackoff=false` in samplekit config to avoid parallel retry storm until patch lands.

Ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/892 :eyes:

dev-bot: @here scheduled staging deploy in 10m — will run samplekit smoke.

Maya: will validate and close the loop. :thumbsup:
